objective: Measure whether ExSpike-APEC-style adjacent-position exact overlap exists in the frozen H67 four bottleneck Conv inputs before considering any new RTL. The audit counts bit-exact nonzero values shared by adjacent spatial positions and charges a frozen H67 overlap-partial-sum width proxy, but intentionally does not convert event reduction into same-resource cycles.

m40_r6.role: validation S10, one Zurich sequence, four frozen H67 ep35 bottleneck Conv inputs

m73.role: train-only calibration S32 over 18 DSEC sequences; robustness support only, never heldout accuracy

external_reference.paper: ExSpike: A General Full-Event Neuromorphic Architecture for Exploiting Irregular Sparsity with Event Compression, FPL 2026
external_reference.borrowed_semantics: For a group of adjacent spike vectors, compute their exact intersection once and then each vector's non-overlap. Eliminated events are (group_size-1)*intersection_population. ExSpike reports that event reduction is not equal to throughput because weight and buffer cycles can dominate.
external_reference.novelty_boundary: APEC is direct prior art. M501 cannot be claimed as a new compression mechanism. The frozen M40/M73 records are zero plus one operator-constant positive amplitude and contain no negative values, so exact-value overlap equals support intersection on this trace and does not activate a general signed-analog novelty delta. Only a later independently demonstrated multi-amplitude/signed H67 capture path with a distinct physical or algorithmic contribution could be considered.

dse.grouping: Non-overlapping contiguous spatial groups; ungrouped border positions retain their original events.
dse.exact_overlap: Every member is nonzero and has the same IEEE-754 float32 bit pattern. Support-only or sign-only equality is not sufficient.
dse.selected_predeclared_point: validation_s10 horizontal G2, matching ExSpike's reported default group size and avoiding post-hoc best-axis selection

cost_model.selected_width_source: Frozen H67 signed19 resident-psum arithmetic proxy; not an ExSpike-published width and not a generated SRAM macro.
cost_model.external_reference_width: ExSpike publishes M_ov approximately Co*k^2*w_acc symbolically; its inspected fixed RTL overlap_cal_res is 16 bit.
not_yet_priced: overlap scratch macro ports and latency
shifted destination commit and border handling

frozen_envelope.meaning: Frozen source-work opportunity envelope used only for Amdahl sensitivity, not a full SRAM/DRAM system cycle result.

decision_gates.meaning: Passing these two opportunity gates only allows a later same-resource cycle fast-kill. It never admits RTL.
decision_gates.new_rtl_gate: Closed until a distinct H67-native novelty delta versus ExSpike, identical-resource cycle model, overlap SRAM/port tax, and independent review all pass.

required_outputs: per-record exact overlap and event counts
validation and train-calibration aggregate by axis/group/operator/sequence
ideal four-Conv envelope sensitivity labeled non-system
exact input and result SHA seal
fail_closed: Abort on docs/359, manifest, compressed payload, decoded payload, shape, dtype, element-count, or nonzero-count mismatch.
Never treat support-only overlap as exact signed-analog reuse.
Record that exact-value overlap equals support intersection for these positive two-codeword traces; do not infer a general signed-analog novelty.
Never call event reduction a cycle or throughput speedup.
Never treat train-only 18-sequence calibration as heldout evaluation.

Never subtract the 16.03125-KiB signed19 overlap-scratch proxy without charging its port, latency, comparator, control, and destination-commit costs; 16/24/32-bit width variants remain a separate DSE.
Never claim APEC itself as project novelty or start RTL from this opportunity result alone.
